jobs.title: Machine Learning Intern
jobs.description: Assist in designing, training, and fine-tuning machine learning models using Python and modern ML frameworks, clean and preprocess large datasets, and collaborate with the engineering team to integrate model prototypes into production.
requirements: Currently pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, data science, statistics, mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
Proficiency in Python (specifically libraries like Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-Learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow).
Solid understanding of machine learning algorithms, statistics, and linear algebra.
Comfortable working with SQL to query and manipulate large datasets.

jobs.title: Junior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: Assist in the development, implementation, and monitoring of machine learning models and algorithms under the guidance of senior engineers, conduct data cleaning and preprocessing, and support model evaluation.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, data science, artificial intelligence, or related field.
Basic practical understanding of machine learning concepts and algorithms.
Familiarity with Python and ML frameworks such as scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or Keras.
Experience with data preprocessing libraries like Pandas and NumPy.

jobs.title: ETIC, Summer Internship - Applied AI
jobs.description: Gain hands-on experience in a dynamic innovation-driven environment, working on real-world projects involving Applied AI and emerging technologies, and collaborate with industry experts.
requirements: Senior undergraduate student (graduating in 2027) in Computer Science, Data Science, AI, or related fields.
Ability to work independently and in a team environment.
Basic understanding of Python or AI/ML concepts.

jobs.title: Intern Software Engineer (Backend)
jobs.description: Participate in a 3-month Youth Internship Program working alongside top professionals in a fast-growing ed-tech company, with a focus on backend software development tasks and learning real-world engineering practices.
requirements: Passionate, driven students or fresh graduates ready to step into the professional world.
Strong problem-solving mindset and eagerness to learn.
Familiarity with backend programming and foundational computer science concepts.
